crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, work on assigned tasks.

crons.name: draft-inbound
crons.prompt: Run draft-inbound skill. Scan new iMessages. Draft replies for anything needing response. Drop into approval queue. Match the user's voice — read voice_profile from org config before drafting.

crons.name: morning-outreach
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not in {08,09,10}, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/morning-outreach-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: run outreach skill. Pull CRM leads using org config + secrets. Draft 5 cold or re-engage texts. Drop into approval queue with thread context for each. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.

crons.name: cooldown-check
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not in {08,12,16,20}, exit silently. Otherwise: scan brew/events.jsonl. Anyone past cooldown ready for re-engage? Draft and queue.
